components: One ingest path creates a versioned segment or operation log.
Immutable segments or ordered updates copy to query replicas.
Checksums and version metadata make a complete version searchable.
Traffic spreads across healthy replicas at acceptable freshness.
Lagging copies fetch missing segments or rebuild from source.
